title: Parkio Daily for September 14, 2026
teaser: Magic of Disney Animation opens today at Hollywood Studios; only one Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party date still has tickets.

rides.name: Slinky Dog Dash
rides.note: Animation opening is pulling crowds to Animation Courtyard; Toy Story Land may see lighter waits early.

rides.name: Test Track
rides.note: Festival season crowds tend to concentrate in World Showcase; ride Future World attractions mid-morning.

rides.name: Big Thunder Mountain
rides.note: Frontierland foot traffic is steady; rope drop or late evening usually yield shortest waits.

breaking.title: The Magic of Disney Animation opens at Hollywood Studios today
breaking.body: The new walk-through experience honoring Walt Disney Animation Studios characters is now open in Animation Courtyard. Disney assembled 60 characters for an opening-day group photo as an homage to Once Upon a Studio. Suzy and Perla from Cinderella are appearing in the courtyard, and limited-edition pins have launched.

parkioInsight.text: Animation Courtyard tends to see heavy foot traffic on attraction opening days, often peaking between 10am and 2pm. Visiting The Magic of Disney Animation early or after 4pm usually offers shorter lines and easier photo opportunities.

breaking.title: Only one Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party date remains available
breaking.body: September 24 and September 29 sold out over the weekend, leaving October 25 as the final 2026 date with tickets. The separately ticketed event costs up to $224 per guest.

parkioInsight.text: October 25 is likely to sell out within days given current demand. If you're planning to attend, booking today is strongly recommended to avoid missing the final 2026 event.

bignews.title: Tapatío replaces Tabasco hot sauce across Walt Disney World
bignews.body: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn and Cafe in Magic Kingdom now stocks Tapatío instead of Tabasco, continuing a resort-wide swap that began last week at ABC Commissary. The change appears to be permanent.

parkioInsight.text: If you prefer a milder, less vinegary hot sauce, Tapatío's flavor profile tends to pair well with burgers and Mexican dishes. Worth trying at Pecos Bill or any quick-service location resort-wide.

bignews.title: New Animation hours reduced by four hours per day starting late September
bignews.body: The Magic of Disney Animation will operate shorter hours beginning two weeks after opening, according to the official Walt Disney World calendar. The experience soft-opened over the weekend ahead of today's official debut.

parkioInsight.text: The first two weeks offer the longest daily windows to visit. If the attraction is a priority, seeing it before the schedule adjusts usually means more flexibility in your park day.

bignews.title: Crowned Athletics Halloween apparel featuring Nightmare Before Christmas arrives
bignews.body: New high-performance activewear collections themed to Halloween and Nightmare Before Christmas are now available at Disney Parks, just in time for the season. Previous Crowned Athletics lines have included Star Wars and other franchises.

parkioInsight.text: Halloween merchandise at Disney tends to sell quickly in popular sizes, especially character-driven collections. Stopping by World of Disney or Emporium before noon often improves selection.

bignews.title: Exclusive cocktail arrives at EPCOT World Showcase
bignews.body: A limited-release drink described as one of the world's most exclusive cocktails is now being served in World Showcase, though specific location and pricing details were not disclosed.

parkioInsight.text: High-demand specialty cocktails in World Showcase often run out by evening, particularly on weekends. Visiting the pavilion mid-afternoon usually increases the chance of availability.

topstories.title: Spring 2027 festival dates and special offers announced for Walt Disney World
topstories.body: EPCOT's International Festival of the Arts returns January 17–February 23, 2027, and the Flower and Garden Festival runs March 10–May 31, 2027. Disney After Hours events are also scheduled for spring across multiple parks, with tickets on sale now.

parkioInsight.text: Booking festival trips in the first or final week of each event usually means lighter crowds and easier dining reservations. Mid-festival weekends tend to see the heaviest foot traffic.

topstories.title: Cake Bake Shop Christmas Dinner with Santa pricing holds at $200+ per guest
topstories.body: The controversial Boardwalk restaurant has not raised prices for its 2026 Christmas dinner event, a rarity for year-over-year pricing at Disney World dining locations.

parkioInsight.text: Character dining reservations at Disney World often book out weeks in advance, especially for holiday events. If this dinner appeals to your party, securing a reservation now is likely your best window.

topstories.title: Four refurbishments ending this month at popular Disneyland hotel
topstories.body: A Disneyland-area hotel is wrapping up four separate closures in late September, though specific venues and reopening dates were not detailed in the source.

parkioInsight.text: Hotel amenity reopenings tend to improve availability for dining, pools, and other services. If you're staying at a Disneyland hotel later this month, checking updated schedules may reveal newly accessible options.

topstories.title: Logo Mania merchandise collection brings colorful Disney Parks apparel
topstories.body: A new line featuring bold graphics tied to favorite attractions, lands, and transportation is now available at Disney Parks. The collection includes six designs celebrating different park elements.

parkioInsight.text: Merchandise tied to specific attractions tends to be stocked most heavily at nearby retail locations. If a particular land or ride is your favorite, shopping at that park's flagship store usually offers the fullest selection.

topstories.title: Halloween and holiday merchandise guides published by Disney Parks
topstories.body: Disney released comprehensive shopping guides for Halloween costumes, seasonal home collections, and holiday gift ideas. The guides highlight product categories and themes available in parks and online.

parkioInsight.text: Seasonal merchandise rollouts at Disney typically see the widest selection in early to mid-September. Waiting until October often means popular sizes and items are already sold out.

topstories.title: Aquatopia closes permanently at Tokyo DisneySea after 25 years
topstories.body: The Port Discovery water ride, an opening-day attraction at Tokyo DisneySea since 2001, took its final spin today. In recent days it offered a special Get Soaked version before closure.

parkioInsight.text: Closures of legacy attractions at international Disney parks often signal similar refurbishments elsewhere. If you have a favorite classic ride at a U.S. park, riding it regularly is wise before any surprise announcements.

topstories.title: Disneyland Paris hits capacity, turns away walk-up guests
topstories.body: Both Disneyland Paris theme parks reached full capacity over the weekend and stopped admitting guests without existing tickets or reservations. The resort issued an official statement confirming the entry shutdown.

parkioInsight.text: Capacity closures at any Disney resort tend to happen on peak weekends and holidays. Always securing dated tickets and park reservations before arrival is the only reliable way to guarantee entry.

icymi.title: Fat One's Hot Dogs opens September 19 at Universal CityWalk with free food
icymi.body: Joey Fatone's restaurant celebrates its grand opening at 10am on September 19 at Universal CityWalk Orlando. The event will feature an appearance by Fatone and complimentary hot dogs for guests.

icymi.title: Limited-edition pins released for Magic of Disney Animation
icymi.body: New collectible pins tied to the Hollywood Studios attraction are now available, including an Olaf Draws design that was previously released in June and has returned for the opening.

icymi.title: Seth Rogen hints Figment movie may still be in development
icymi.body: The actor addressed the long-dormant Figment film project for the first time in four years, offering a tease that the EPCOT-inspired feature might not be dead. This follows D23 Expo news of a Journey into Imagination reimagining.

spotlight.title: Once Upon a Studio tribute photo brings 60 characters together
spotlight.body: To celebrate the Magic of Disney Animation opening, Walt Disney World recreated the iconic group shot from the Once Upon a Studio short film. Sixty Disney characters—both common and rare—assembled for the photo, mirroring the animated tribute that inspired the new experience.

parkioInsight.text: Character meet opportunities in Animation Courtyard tend to be most diverse during opening weeks of new attractions. Visiting today or this week often means encountering rare characters before rotations settle into a regular schedule.
